facts.text: Serve the soup when Sally brings Dr Finkelstein his supper.
facts.why: In the film Sally serves the doctor his soup with the call 'Lunch!', and she secretly slips Deadly Nightshade into it. It is lunch, not supper.
facts.fix: Serve the soup when Sally brings Dr Finkelstein his lunch.

facts.text: Jack, eat something before you plan anything. I made the soup, no frog's breath.
facts.why: Sally never says this, and she never speaks to Jack about soup. Her real soup line, to Dr Finkelstein, is 'What's wrong? I thought you liked frog's breath.'
facts.fix: What's wrong? I thought you liked frog's breath.

fix_note.text: What's wrong? I thought you liked frog's breath.
